config_beautifier.description: Format the generated nginx configs (env DISABLE_NGINX_BEAUTIFIER, inverted)

gravatar.description: Fetch Gravatar profile pictures, sends a hash of the email address to Gravatar (env DISABLE_GRAVATAR, inverted)

locked.description: Fields set by environment variables (read only)

locked_by.description: The environment variable that sets each locked field (read only)

locked_reason.description: Fields locked by the environment variable of another setting (an indirect lock), with the reason: key-size (the key type follows ACME_KEY_SIZE), ocsp-stapling-off (Must-Staple is off because ACME_OCSP_STAPLING turns OCSP stapling off), must-staple (OCSP stapling is required by ACME_MUST_STAPLE), goaccess (GoAccess reads the log files). Fields locked by their own variable are not listed.

applies.description: When a change of each field takes effect
